item.title: PyXHDL - Python Frontend For VHDL And Verilog
item.description: PyXHDL allows to write HDL code in Python, generating VHDL (>= 2008) and Verilog (SystemVerilog >= 2012) code to be used for synthesis and simulation. PyXHDL does not try to create an IR to be lowered, but instead interprets Python AST code and maps that directly into the selected HDL backend code. The optimizations are left to the OEM HDL compiler used to syntesize the design. The main advantage of PyXHDL is that you can write functions and modules/entities wihtout explicit parametrization.
